name: programmer
description: Finds code that breaks book-derived principles. A deterministic Python scanner with 20 detected rules (DRY, small functions, crash early, Law of Demeter, shared state, injection, dependency rule, inheritance tax, CQS and more), each tied to a book and tip and proven by fixtures; JSON and SARIF output for CI. A cited model judge covers what code cannot decide. 2 skills (review, principles) and 1 agent (principles-judge).
